chunks: He said: "You will find me patient, if God wills, and I will not disobey you in any thing."
ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to Pharaoh regarding his patience and obedience?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as Moses' declaration to Pharaoh, emphasizing his reliance on divine will ('insha'Allah') and his unwavering patience (sabr) in the face of tyranny. It underscores the prophetic model of combining inner spiritual fortitude with outward obedience to God's command, serving as a paradigm for believers confronting oppression. The phrase reflects the balance between human effort and divine decree, a key theme in Shia theological discourse.
